data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 abstracts SRC_004: the optimization-basin saddle-crossing model is an instance of the broader institutional-constraint rational-optimization pattern, where the agent's optimization metric (loss landscape) is a concrete realization of the institutional constraint (ownership lineage). This abstraction is REFUTED IF the shared structure breaks down because research-programme landscapes are co-constructed by the frames used to search them, making the fixed-landscape assumption of gradient descent a substantive disanalogy rather than a mere implementation detail.
